title: nan
authors: Schleich D.; Quenzel J.; Behnke S.
key_contribution: Presents a remote autonomy system for multiple consumer-grade UAVs in GNSS-denied search and rescue using onboard state estimation, obstacle avoidance, and joint 3D environment modeling.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
